scope: Original Maven JavaHost target/dependency snapshot; 59 runtime JARs; not a declaration about the new host or its licensing

definitions.matched-release-source-collected: Exact release/tag archive retained; all JAR native entries match archived binary bytes; source/build inputs and license files retained. This is not a claim of complete corresponding source provenance.
definitions.pending-engine-source-commit: External linked native engine source commit not identified; source closure incomplete.
definitions.minimal-rebuild-path: A from-pinned-public-source rebuild recipe that REPLACES the opaque upstream prebuilt natives with VodBox-built binaries. It does not retroactively prove the old publisher's provenance; it makes VodBox's own distributed natives corresponding-source-complete once executed and recorded.

minimal_rebuild_path.public_evidence_conclusion: Public evidence inspected in the bounded provenance pass (upstream-evidence/native-provenance/REPORT.md) does not establish the exact external Unicorn engine commit for the published unidbg-unicorn2:0.9.8 prebuilt libraries, nor the exact Android platform manifest / final hook revisions for the packaged guest libraries. The release tree has zero gitlinks, no .gitmodules and no CI, so no source-to-binary pin exists to recover.
minimal_rebuild_path.strategy: Rather than assert the old binary matches a guessed commit, rebuild the native backend and guest SDK/hook libraries from fixed public source versions + licenses, so the distributed source exactly corresponds to the distributed new binaries.
minimal_rebuild_path.preserves_compatibility_layer: Upstream JavaHost and vodbox-adapter are reused unchanged; rebuilt natives are drop-in behind the same JVM-visible API. No compatibility shim is rewritten.
does_not_claim: That any rebuilt library byte-matches an upstream prebuilt binary.
That the upstream Java sources cover the native source (they do not).
That a guessed commit proves the historical publisher provenance.
minimal_rebuild_path.boundaries: No build/test/typecheck was performed here; scripts are provided unexecuted. No change to build.yml, build/*.py, release code, or the default runtime backend. No dependency version bump.

license_facts.summary: The LICENSE governing each guest file IS established from the strings observed in the retained binaries, even though the exact AOSP tag/module is not. All 26 SDK libs plus xHook/whale/Dobby/HookZz are PERMISSIVE (notice-only, no source obligation). The GPL-2.0 corresponding-source obligation belongs solely to the Unicorn engine (unidbg-unicorn2), NOT to these guest libs. libhookzz.so's license is now established as Apache-2.0 (was previously recorded unknown); only its exact historical source revision remains unresolved, which is a provenance/rebuild question, not a license question.
class_permissive_notice_only: bionic libc.so/libdl.so/libm.so/liblog.so -> BSD-family (notice-only; bionic BSD does NOT require full source)
bionic libc++ libstdcpp.so/libcpp.so -> MIT / Illinois-BSD dual (notice-only)
sdk19 libcrypto.so/libssl.so -> OpenSSL 1.0.1e dual OpenSSL+SSLeay (strings 'external/openssl/...', 'OpenSSL 1.0.1e 11 Feb 2013'); NOT BoringSSL
sdk23 libcrypto.so/libssl.so -> BoringSSL, OpenSSL+SSLeay+Google-ISC era text (strings 'external/boringssl/...', 'BoringSSL')
libxhook.so -> MIT + BSD-2 (tree.h) + BSD-3 (queue.h), docs CC-BY-4.0 (notice-only)
libhookzz.so -> HookZz, Apache-2.0 (notice-only); jmpews/HookZz renamed to jmpews/Dobby, project LICENSE + mirror forks byte-identical Apache-2.0; exact historical source revision still unresolved
class_gpl_corresponding_source: Unicorn engine statically linked into unidbg-unicorn2 natives/{libunicorn.so,libunicorn.dylib,unicorn.dll} -> GPL-2.0; requires engine corresponding source (see REPORT.md). This is the ONLY full-source obligation in this dependency.
rebuild_or_drop_source_only: libhookzz.so -> HookZz exact historical source revision unresolved (license IS known: Apache-2.0); Dobby is not its ABI
licenses_physically_retained: OpenSSL 1.0.1e dual OpenSSL+SSLeay LICENSE text - upstream-reference/openssl-1.0.1e/LICENSE
BoringSSL LICENSE text (AOSP android-6.0.1_r1 era) - upstream-reference/boringssl/LICENSE
